kurz: Short-grain rice releases plenty of starch into milk and binds it into a creamy pudding when it cooks slowly.
bild_im_kopf: Like a ball of wool slowly melting into a warm blanket.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Use short-grain rice and do not rinse it
schluesselmomente.warum: Short-grain rice has a lot of starch that escapes easily. That is exactly what makes the [[milch|milk]] creamy.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Simmer gently for 30–40 minutes, stirring often
schluesselmomente.warum: Milk proteins and [[milchzucker|lactose]] settle on the bottom and catch easily on high heat.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add the sugar towards the end
schluesselmomente.warum: Sugar binds water and slows the starch from [[quellen|swelling]].

schluesselmomente.schritt: Take it off the heat a little runnier than it should be
schluesselmomente.warum: It thickens noticeably as it cools.
